findings.summary: validate="many_to_one" raises MergeError if customers has duplicate customer_id values, and the docstring doesn't mention this; the reviewer suggests dropping duplicates first if tolerance is wanted.
fillna("unknown") raises TypeError when region is a categorical dtype because "unknown" isn't an existing category.
Matched customers with a null region are also relabelled "unknown", which differs from the docstring saying only unmatched orders get that label.
count on order_id skips null IDs, so rows with null order_id are not counted; size would count every row.
Sorting by revenue with the default sort isn't stable, so regions with equal revenue come out in arbitrary order; use kind="stable" or a secondary key.
